parts.name: Button (Left Click)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left button of the computer mouse, made of ABS plastic, typically around 3 cm long and 2 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for primary clicking actions such as selecting, dragging, and interacting with software interfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the scroll wheel of the mouse, made of rubber for grip, approximately 1.5 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to scroll vertically or horizontally through content on a screen.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its horizontal axis and may also be pressed for additional input functions.

parts.name: Button (Right Click)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right button of the computer mouse, made of ABS plastic, similar in size to the left button.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for secondary actions such as opening context menus or performing alternate commands.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the mouse, made of ABS plastic, forming the structural shell of the device.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal components such as sensors, circuit board, and provides ergonomic support for the hand.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to its internal components but moves as a whole across a surface during use.
